notes: Angle: account microcopy, not a sales page — the reader is an existing client mid-task and suspicious of subscriptions, so every line is fact, reassurance, next step. Zero marketing.

Two-step cancel is new as of today: the WHERE note on button.idle (one click, no dialog) is outdated. Wire cancelConfirm.question after the first tap; yes calls the cancel API, back only closes the question. button.loading/done/error strings still apply after yes.

renewal.body uses {price} instead of {amount} {currency}; code renders one formatted VAT-inclusive string (e.g. 234.82 ₪ כולל מע״מ). The recurringAmount row label assumes the same monthly VAT-inclusive value.

success.message and magicLink.subject/body now describe the full account page (manage, card, support, cancel), not a cancel link. The conditional 'if an account exists' phrasing is preserved so the reply stays identical whether or not the email exists.
metadata.title is only the part before the suffix; code appends '‏ | WAO'. It ends in Hebrew, no Latin token.

All three generic errors use one identical string pointing to the message box on this page ('תיבת ההודעות בעמוד הזה') — align this name with the actual UI label. In no-token states the box may not render; confirm placement, per the brief's instruction to always point there.
Placeholders kept exactly in braces: {price}, {cardLast4}, {cardExpiry}, {date}. URLs ({manageUrl}, {updateCardUrl}, {cancelUrl}) stay on their own lines, untouched.

30-minute link validity is stated in link.expired and in both email link lines. used/invalid states point to the request form below. Cancel-by-button-only, never by message, is stated in renewal.cancelLine.
done.message and state.cancelScheduled are intentionally identical — same fact, mutually exclusive states, never co-rendered. Same for the three generic errors.

Typography: maqaf (־) before numbers and Latin tokens, em-dash with single spaces, U+2026 ellipsis, no ASCII quotes inside strings. Status values are short chips (בהמתנה / פעיל / באיחור / בוטל / מושהה) — QA to confirm fit.
